marks.gloss_en: מאי טעמא? איגלאי מילתא למפרע דפירא הוא
temed that one bought with tithe money and that in the end fermented -- the tithe has acquired
לאו אמר רבי יוחנן בתר חזותא אזלינן? הכא נמי זיל בתר חזותא, וטעמא וחזותא דהאי מיא נינהו
and the taste and appearance of this one are water
דלמא אתי לאפרושי מן החיוב על הפטור ומן הפטור על החיוב -- the stam's account of R' Elazar's reason
he holds: where it did not ferment -- [there] is the dispute

אלא מתניתין דקתני החמיץ אין, לא החמיץ לא -- דלמא אי שבקיה הוה מחמיץ! -- if purchase is decided retroactively, how can the mishna flatly say unfermented temed is not bought? perhaps left alone it would have fermented
כששייר ממנו בכוס ולא החמיץ -- where he left some in a cup and it did not ferment (= p_sheiyer_bekos)
Rabba: where he left some of it in a cup and it did not ferment
הא מני? רבי יוחנן בן נורי היא -- the mishna is R' Yochanan ben Nuri's, who follows present appearance (= p_matnitin_kerybn); that this answers 26a.3 is Steinsaltz's reading
Rava: whose is this? it is R' Yochanan ben Nuri's
and the mishna is R' Yehuda's
three log of water less a kortov, into which a kortov of milk fell, and their appearance is like water, and they fell into a mikveh -- they did not invalidate it
R' Yochanan ben Nuri says: everything follows the appearance
R' Elazar: all agree that one does not separate for it from another place, unless it fermented
